content.introTitle: Integrating Engineering Rigor with Natural Climate Solutions in Nigeria
content.introBody: Headquartered in Port Harcourt with a regional presence in Abuja, TerraNova Energy Limited operates at the intersection of industrial decarbonization, renewable power development, carbon solutions, and ecological restoration. We work to build practical frameworks that align Nigeria’s energy requirements with long-term environmental stewardship and community prosperity.

content.sustainabilityPreviewBody: Lasting environmental progress in the Niger Delta and across Nigeria depends on respectful consultation, local capacity building, youth technical training, and women’s inclusion in clean energy value chains.

content.aboutOverview: TerraNova Energy Limited (Registered in Nigeria under RC Number: 9478210) is a corporate energy and environmental solutions enterprise focused on supporting the transition toward lower-carbon operations, renewable energy deployment, and nature-based climate resilience.
content.aboutPositioning: Operating from Port Harcourt in Rivers State and Abuja, the company is positioned to connect technical engineering capabilities, environmental science, and local stakeholder engagement. Rather than treating energy security and environmental protection as competing priorities, TerraNova Energy Limited focuses on practical pathways where emissions reduction, clean power generation, and ecosystem conservation reinforce one another.
content.visionStatement: To contribute to a sustainable future through innovative energy solutions, responsible carbon initiatives, and environmental stewardship.
content.missionStatement: To develop and support practical energy and environmental solutions that create long-term value for partners, communities, and the environment.

coreValues.title: Integrity
coreValues.description: Maintaining transparent governance, accurate environmental reporting, and honest communication with regulators, investors, and host communities.

coreValues.title: Innovation
coreValues.description: Applying modern engineering practices, clean energy architectures, and digital monitoring tools suited to Nigerian operational contexts.

coreValues.title: Environmental Responsibility
coreValues.description: Prioritizing measurable emissions abatement, biodiversity protection, and the restoration of sensitive coastal and terrestrial ecosystems.

coreValues.title: Collaboration
coreValues.description: Building structured partnerships across energy operators, technical specialists, research bodies, government institutions, and climate financiers.

coreValues.title: Community Impact
coreValues.description: Respecting local priorities through consultative engagement, skills transfer, youth empowerment, and inclusive participation.

coreValues.title: Long-Term Value Creation
coreValues.description: Designing initiatives for operational durability, environmental permanence, and sustained socioeconomic benefit.

content.sustainabilityCommitment: TerraNova Energy Limited approaches sustainability as an operational discipline. Every proposed initiative is evaluated for technical feasibility, environmental integrity, transparent baseline accounting, and constructive alignment with host community livelihoods.
content.energyTransitionStrategy: Our strategy bridges conventional energy sector decarbonization with scalable renewable energy and nature-based carbon initiatives. By addressing process efficiency and flare reduction alongside solar deployment and mangrove conservation, we aim to support a pragmatic, well-governed transition pathway.
content.communityCommitment: We recognize that environmental and energy initiatives succeed only when local communities are respected participants. Our approach emphasizes early consultation, transparent grievance channels, gender-inclusive training opportunities, and practical livelihood support.

services.title: Decarbonization Engineering
services.subtitle: Practical engineering assessments, energy efficiency, and operational emissions reduction
services.overview: We support industrial operators, energy facilities, and commercial enterprises in identifying and evaluating technical pathways to lower greenhouse gas intensity. Through process audits, electrification feasibility studies, waste-heat recovery analysis, and methane/flare abatement planning, our engineering framework helps organizations transition toward cleaner, more efficient operations.
benefits: Structured identification of operational energy losses and fugitive emissions sources
Engineering feasibility studies for hybrid solar-industrial power integration
Alignment of facility operations with emerging domestic and international ESG disclosure standards
Pragmatic phased implementation roadmaps tailored to Nigerian industrial infrastructure
applications: Oil and gas midstream and upstream facility efficiency assessments
Flare gas utilization and methane leak detection planning
Commercial and industrial captive power hybridization (diesel-to-solar transition)
Energy efficiency retrofits for processing and logistics facilities
services.imageAlt: TerraNova Energy Limited Decarbonization Engineering and technical solutions

services.title: Carbon Credit Solutions
services.subtitle: Carbon project structuring, baseline accounting, and technical partner coordination
services.overview: TerraNova Energy Limited develops frameworks for high-integrity carbon initiatives across both technological avoidance/reduction and nature-based removals. We work alongside independent technical specialists, monitoring partners, and project stakeholders to structure project design documents, establish defensible emissions baselines, and prepare initiatives for recognized carbon market standards.
benefits: Rigorous project screening for additionality, permanence, and leakage risk management
Transparent greenhouse gas baseline modeling and monitoring protocol design
Coordination with accredited third-party validation and verification bodies (VVBs)
Equitable benefit-sharing frameworks for community-linked carbon initiatives
applications: Nature-based reforestation and coastal wetland carbon project preparation
Clean distributed energy and industrial emissions-reduction project structuring
Corporate carbon inventory scoping and climate transition advisory
Joint venture development for climate finance readiness
services.imageAlt: Renewable energy and carbon project structuring in Nigeria
services.disclaimer: Notice: TerraNova Energy Limited facilitates project development, emissions accounting, and technical coordination. Carbon credit issuance is always subject to independent validation, verification, and registration by accredited international or domestic standards bodies.

services.title: Blue Carbon and Mangrove Restoration
services.subtitle: Coastal ecosystem recovery, biodiversity protection, and Niger Delta resilience
services.overview: Nigeria’s coastal mangrove forests—particularly across the Niger Delta—represent vital ecological buffers and high-capacity natural carbon sinks. We design collaborative restoration and conservation initiatives focused on rehabilitating degraded tidal wetlands, protecting estuarine biodiversity, reducing coastal erosion, and supporting community-based nursery stewardship.
benefits: High-density natural carbon sequestration in mangrove biomass and tidal sediment soils
Natural shoreline stabilization and flood resilience for coastal settlements
Habitat recovery for estuarine fisheries and native Niger Delta biodiversity
Direct participation of local communities, women, and youth in seedling nurseries and site stewardship
applications: Degraded tidal creek and estuary hydrology assessment and replanting
Community-managed mangrove seedling nurseries and ecological monitoring
Biodiversity corridor conservation in coastal Rivers State and neighboring delta regions
Blue carbon feasibility studies for institutional climate finance partners
services.imageAlt: Nigerian conservationists and Niger Delta community members planting mangrove saplings along a coastal estuary

services.title: AI-Driven Environmental Monitoring
services.subtitle: Geospatial intelligence, remote sensing, and digital measurement, reporting, and verification (dMRV)
services.overview: Credible environmental management requires continuous, verifiable data. We integrate satellite earth observation, drone photogrammetry, field sensor networks, and analytical models to monitor vegetation health, land-use change, biomass growth, and environmental indicators across project sites.
benefits: Objective, repeatable spatial tracking of reforestation and mangrove canopy recovery
Early detection of environmental stressors, encroachment, or pipeline corridor anomalies
Streamlined data aggregation for investor reporting, regulatory compliance, and audit trails
Reduced cost and higher spatial accuracy compared to manual-only field surveys
applications: Digital Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (dMRV) for carbon and restoration projects
Multispectral drone mapping of coastal wetlands and agricultural buffers
Environmental baseline assessments and ongoing ecological impact tracking
Spatial decision-support dashboards for project partners and regulators
services.imageAlt: Nigerian environmental data researcher operating a survey drone and field geospatial laptop near a tropical river corridor

content.communityIntro: At TerraNova Energy Limited, responsible environmental stewardship is inseparable from the wellbeing of Nigerian communities—particularly in the Niger Delta and host regions where energy and conservation activities take place. Below we outline our consultation principles and proposed community sustainability programmes.
content.communityHeroAlt: Community consultation and clean-energy technical training workshop in Nigeria with women, youth, and facilitators

communitySections.title: Community Engagement and Consultation
communitySections.description: Before initiating field assessments or project development, our framework prioritizes open, respectful dialogue with traditional authorities, local leadership, youth groups, and women’s associations to ensure local priorities inform project design.
keyPoints: Early, transparent disclosure of proposed project scopes and environmental objectives
Respect for local customs, land-use practices, and estuarine fishing livelihoods
Accessible channels for community feedback and continuous dialogue

communitySections.title: Community Trust Committees (Where Established)
communitySections.description: As site-specific projects are formally established with host communities, TerraNova Energy Limited proposes to work through representative Community Trust Committees to guide local participation and benefit governance. (Note: Specific committees are formed only upon formal project commencement with host communities.)
keyPoints: Joint representation including elders, youth representatives, and women leaders
Transparent oversight of community-linked project milestones
Alignment with applicable Nigerian host-community engagement guidelines

communitySections.title: Youth Empowerment and Technical Skills Development
communitySections.description: Nigeria’s young workforce is central to the clean energy transition. Our proposed project models incorporate practical training in solar installation maintenance, nursery management, GPS field mapping, and environmental data collection.
keyPoints: Hands-on field training in ecological monitoring and seedling propagation
Introductory technical modules on solar PV maintenance and safety
Pathways for local youth participation in environmental survey teams

communitySections.title: Women’s Participation and Inclusion
communitySections.description: Women in coastal and rural Nigerian communities play a vital role in local agriculture, fisheries processing, and household energy management. We design proposed initiatives to support equitable participation by women in nursery stewardship, clean energy access, and project consultation.
keyPoints: Dedicated consultation sessions to incorporate women’s perspectives in project planning
Opportunities in community mangrove nurseries and sustainable agro-forestry supply chains
Support for clean energy solutions that improve productive livelihoods

communitySections.title: Environmental Awareness, Mangrove Protection & Biodiversity
communitySections.description: Protecting mangrove ecosystems against unsustainable harvesting and degradation requires shared ecological stewardship. We promote environmental education alongside practical conservation incentives that support native fish breeding grounds and shoreline stability.
keyPoints: Community-focused awareness on the role of mangroves in flood protection and fisheries
Collaborative biodiversity monitoring and protection of regenerating wetland zones
Promotion of sustainable local livelihoods compatible with ecosystem recovery

communitySections.title: Social Infrastructure: Schools, Clinics, and Water Projects (Where Applicable)
communitySections.description: Where project scale, partner funding, and community needs align, future long-term initiatives may support targeted community infrastructure such as solar-powered water boreholes, rural clinic electrification, or educational facility support. No completed school, clinic, or water infrastructure projects are claimed at this stage.
keyPoints: Needs-based assessment conducted directly with host community representatives
Focus on clean water access and solar electrification for essential community facilities
Implemented strictly in partnership with verified funding institutions and local authorities

content.privacyPolicyText:
1. Introduction
TerraNova Energy Limited (RC Number: 9478210), with offices at 123 Energy Way, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria and 45 Diplomatic Drive, Abuja, Nigeria ("we", "our", or "the Company"), respects the privacy of visitors to our corporate website. This policy outlines how information submitted through our website is handled.

2. Information We Collect
We collect personal and organizational contact details that you voluntarily provide when submitting our Contact Form or Partnership Inquiry Form, including your full name, organization name, email address, telephone number, inquiry category, and message content.

3. How We Use Information
Submitted inquiries are used strictly to:
• Respond to your business, partnership, regulatory, or community inquiries;
• Evaluate potential technical, investment, or sustainability collaborations;
• Maintain the security and operational integrity of our website and administrator portal.

4. Data Storage and Security
Inquiries submitted via this website are stored in our protected backend database for review by authorized TerraNova Energy Limited personnel. We do not sell or rent visitor contact information to third parties.

5. Your Choices and Contact
If you wish to request the update or deletion of contact details you have submitted to us, please contact us directly at terranovaenergylimited@gmail.com or call +234 701 650 4968.
content.termsText:
1. Corporate Information & Scope
This website is operated by TerraNova Energy Limited (Registered in Nigeria, RC Number: 9478210), with its Corporate Head Office at 123 Energy Way, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria, and Regional Office at 45 Diplomatic Drive, Abuja, Nigeria.

2. Informational Purpose & Non-Reliance
All content on this website—including proposed strategic targets, project concepts, demonstration portfolio items, and sustainability roadmaps—is provided for general corporate informational purposes only. Nothing on this website constitutes a binding financial offer or securities solicitation unless accompanied by formal, executed transaction documentation.

3. Illustrative & Demonstration Content
Certain photographs, proposed impact figures (such as proposed MW capacity, carbon offset targets, restoration hectare targets, and green job targets), and demonstration project entries are presented to illustrate the Company’s strategic focus areas and technical capabilities. They are clearly labeled as proposed targets or demonstration concepts until replaced with verified project records.

4. Intellectual Property & Acceptable Use
Visitors may view and download publicly available information for legitimate business evaluation. Unauthorized attempts to access the /admin portal, bypass authentication controls, submit automated spam, or disrupt website operations are strictly prohibited.

5. Contact
For formal inquiries regarding these Terms and Conditions, please email terranovaenergylimited@gmail.com.

projects.title: Niger Delta Estuarine Mangrove Restoration & Blue Carbon Initiative
projects.location: Coastal Estuary Corridor, Rivers State, Nigeria (Proposed Scope)
projects.summary: Demonstration project framework for community-led mangrove rehabilitation, tidal hydrology assessment, and blue carbon baseline scoping in coastal Rivers State.
projects.description:
This demonstration entry illustrates TerraNova Energy Limited’s project development methodology for coastal blue carbon and mangrove restoration in the Niger Delta. The proposed framework combines multispectral drone baseline mapping, community-managed Rhizophora seedling nurseries, and hydrological channel clearing to restore degraded tidal flats while supporting estuarine fishery habitats.

Notice: This entry is presented as demonstration content illustrating proposed project architecture prior to formal site sign-off and third-party registry validation.
impactIndicators: Target Scope: Phased coastal mangrove seedling propagation and tidal wetland recovery (Proposed)
Methodology: High-resolution geospatial canopy monitoring and sediment carbon sampling (Proposed)
Community Role: Local women and youth nursery stewardship and field monitoring teams (Proposed)
